model.stratum: Four saved complex permutation maps on C5, eight recorded PE products, a declared reference symplectic form and positive mismatch penalty. Oppositely oriented boundary ports and same-sign auxiliary dynamical copies are distinct carriers; neither parameter is physical time.
model.next_falsifier: The preserved symplectic squeeze already refutes symplecticity-alone as a stability criterion. Any physical stabilizer claim must supply its actual dynamical form and restoring law rather than identify the boundary relation with dynamics.
